decisions.diagnosis: The record rain of 8-10 Feb 2020; every nearby counter also read 0 on the 9th, so the full-day zero is probably real riding.
decisions.evidence: 2020-02-09: 0 in both directions here and at all four Parramatta River N directions (sites 190/191), which read 13-17 on the 8th and 4-30 on the 10th; 122 had 5/5 on the 8th.

summary: One Metrocount piezo (counter 120) at Darcy Rd from Oct 2011 to Sep 2026, one record per slot, with no doubling or duplication and a data gap from Oct 2021 to Jul 2022. The zero_outage fixes are right for the real outages (both directions dead while neighbours rode: 20-26 May 2017, 19-26 Mar 2021, 22 Feb 2024, 23 Oct 2025, and also 11 Jun 2012 and 25 Dec 2012), but they wrongly blanked single-direction or site-wide near-zero storm days, which are restored. Two high readings are kept as real: 1,229 bikes SE-bound on Sunday 14 Oct 2012 (a smooth 08:30-13:30 one-way wave, almost certainly an organised ride), and SE-bound roughly doubling from 15 to 28 Feb 2013 with an added PM peak, which the independent Elizabeth St Bridge counter shows on the same dates.
